items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a drummer with me named Jimmy King was our first vocalist.

ctx.x: He didn't think anything about the saxophone (inaudible), but he idolized Coleman Hawkins. So Ben wasn't much for

classes so he disappeared one time. He was our valet. He used to go around, set the band up and everything, help -- so he disappeared -- we didn't see him for almost a year, and the next time we saw him he had a horn, and he was doing pretty good on it. He always had that tone, from the very beginning. And he said, "Coleman Hawkins is my idol. I'm back to Wilberforce, and why, he went right up. Well, that helped us. I had quite a few musicians, as I mentioned before, from Birmingham, Alabama. We formed the…
